# Tesla Stock Could Sink In The Last Half Of 2026—Here’s Why
## Why Tesla Stock Could Sink In Second Half Of 2026
### High Valuation
Tesla’s valuation is nearly 15 times higher than the vehicles and parts industry average. At roughly [$408 per share on July 10](https://www.google.com/search?q=tesla+stock&sca_esv=98ee674815491cbe&rlz=1C1GCEA_enUS1120US1120&biw=1396&bih=719&sxsrf=APpeQnuck-9YgSi9KC9cXMdw9bR8Rvm-rA%3A1783943745986&ei=QdJUav_pO4WqptQP3IfSgAI&ved=0ahUKEwi_jp2qzM-VAxUFlYkEHdyDFCAQ4dUDCBA&uact=5&oq=tesla+stock&gs_-wCwgcFMC41LjHIBw6ACAE&sclient=gws-wiz-serp) [and a $1.28 trillion stock market capitalization,](https://tickernerd.com/stock/tsla-forecast/) Tesla traded at a price/earnings ratio of 373 and the company’s forward PE of around [192x](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/tsla/statistics/) was 14.7 times more than the [vehicles and parts industry median forward P/E near 13x](https://www.gurufocus.com/term/forward-pe-ratio/TSLA).
